# Atlas launch plan

The Atlas pilot begins on 14 October with twelve design partners. The group will use the product for two weeks before the first reliability review.

## Rollout stages

Stage one is limited to the design-partner cohort. Stage two expands access to fifty customers only after the error budget remains below two percent for seven consecutive days.

## Support coverage

During the pilot, support coverage runs from 08:00 to 20:00 UTC on weekdays. Critical incidents are escalated to the on-call engineering lead.

## Exit criteria

The pilot is complete when all launch-blocking issues are closed, the reliability target is sustained, and at least eight design partners approve the workflow.
